Title: Unexpected strength–ductility response in an annealed, metastable, high-entropy alloy
Primary_Reason: New non-equiatomic HEA family with FSP + annealing; directly reported pre-test FCC/HCP fractions for ten processing states; direct tensile FCC->HCP TRIP and HCP epsilon-phase twinning for 650-15 and 850-30; strong processing-microstructure-mechanism coupling.
